tests.expect: flock held by the holder is visible to others, and is released by the kernel when the holder is SIGKILLed
tests.name: flock-released-on-sigkill
tests.note: lock visible while held, released on SIGKILL

tests.expect: a child that inherited the fd keeps the lock after the parent is SIGKILLed (open-file-description semantics); released only when the child dies
tests.name: flock-fd-inherited-keeps-lock
tests.note: inherited fd keeps the lock after parent death

tests.expect: the fd received over a socket keeps the lock after the sender is SIGKILLed; released when the receiver closes it
tests.name: flock-fd-passed-by-scm-rights

tests.expect: killpg kills every process of a group, including grandchildren
tests.name: process-group-kill

tests.expect: macOS: the escaper SURVIVES the group kill and is reparented to launchd (confirms best-effort level); linux control: same without a PID namespace
tests.name: setsid-double-fork-escaper
tests.note: escaper survived the group kill (pgroup kill is best-effort)

data.psMethodNote: ps -axo uses sysctl KERN_PROC on macOS

tests.expect: a descendant scan finds every process of a 40-process tree and a stop-rescan-kill pass ends them all; timings are the cost of pgroup-tree kill_all
tests.name: tree-scan-and-kill-all
tests.note: scan found the full tree and kill_all ended it

tests.expect: kill the holder while git is blocked in a hook: lock is never observed free while git or its hook children are alive (windows: they all die with the job; unix: lock stays held through the inherited fd)
tests.name: git-borrow-blocking-hook
tests.note: lock never free while git or its children were alive

tests.expect: same invariant with gc.auto=1 and loose objects, killing the holder as soon as git returns while a detached gc and a background hook child may still run
tests.name: git-borrow-auto-gc
tests.note: lock never free while git or its children were alive

tests.expect: 50 repeats: a contender that applies the predecessor rule never proceeds while git or its hook children are alive (0 violations); extra wait is small
tests.name: git-borrow-blocking-hook-predecessor-check
tests.note: 0 violations: contender proceeded only after the predecessor domain was empty

tests.expect: documents the hazard: when only the holder owns the job, its name can vanish (open fails = looks empty) while members are still terminating; informational, never fails
tests.name: git-borrow-blocking-hook-predecessor-check-holder-owned
tests.note: holder-owned job: 1/50 repeats proceeded while members were still dying (job name already gone in 50 of them)

tests.expect: a record pointing to an already-destroyed domain lets the contender proceed immediately
tests.name: predecessor-record-stale

tests.expect: members that do not die within the drain window are terminated by the contender, which then proceeds with nothing alive (or returns held); it never proceeds with live members
tests.name: predecessor-drain-timeout
tests.note: drain expired, contender terminated the members and proceeded with nothing alive

tests.expect: informational: whether the terminal-pane transport can exist on this OS
tests.name: herdr-on-path
